meta.title: Hlas: offline dictation for Mac and Windows, 4 MB
meta.description: Hold Fn, speak, release. Your words land where the cursor is, in any app. A 4 MB native app, 60 MB of RAM when idle, offline Whisper. Free, or unlimited with Hlas Cloud for €35 a year.
meta.ogTitle: Hlas: dictation for Mac and Windows
meta.ogDescription: Hold Fn, speak, release. 4 MB app, 60 MB RAM when idle, works offline.

hero.badge: New: Hlas Cloud, unlimited for €35 a year
hero.h1: Dictation for Mac and Windows that just works.
hero.sub: Hold <kbd>Fn</kbd>, speak, release. The text lands where your cursor is, in any app. A 4 MB app that idles at 60 MB of RAM.
hero.note: Apple Silicon, macOS 15+ · 4 MB · Windows 10 and 11 in beta, installer not signed yet
hero.privacy: In local mode there is no account and your audio never leaves your computer.

The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Every comma and capital letter in place.

features.h2:
Everything you need to stop typing.
Nothing you don't.

offline.p: Whisper runs right on your machine. Audio never leaves it.

vocab.p: Names, brands and jargon. Tell Hlas how it mishears them.
vocab.strong: It gets them right from then on.

smart.p: Turns rambling into clean paragraphs or lists, chosen from what you meant.
smart.strong: The original always stays in History.
smart.raw: um so tomorrow I need to buy milk and then bread too and uh call Sarah
smart.title: Tomorrow

langs.p: Whisper large-v3 writes English with punctuation and capitals where they belong.

mini.p: Drop in a recording up to 10 minutes long and get the text.
Hold Fn to talk. Tap it once for hands-free, tap again to stop.
Fn, right Option, right Command, right Control or F13 to F19.
Searchable, local, clearable. Paste the last dictation again with one shortcut.

perf.h2: Lighter than the tab you forgot to close.

ram.p: The model loads when you speak and unloads after 3 minutes of silence.
ram.foot: Hlas measured on an M1 Pro with the app hidden. While the local model is loaded it uses about 1 GB. Competitor figure from our own comparison.

size.p: Native Swift on Mac, native Rust on Windows. No Electron.

speed.h3: Faster than you can reread it
speed.p: Local model on Apple Silicon, Metal accelerated.

fill.p: Hesitations like um, uh and hmm are removed locally, in every mode.

sym.p: Spoken symbols and line breaks, in English and Czech. A Labs feature.

apps.p: If you can type there, you can dictate there.

langs.h2: Built in Prague for languages that big apps treat as an afterthought.

points.p: Whisper large-v3 writes capitals, commas and question marks, not one long lowercase line.
Pin the languages you use or leave Hlas on auto-detect. English terms inside other languages stay intact.
Teach Hlas names and jargon once in the vocabulary, and it writes them your way from then on.

items.q: Is the free version really free?
items.a: Yes. The local engine runs on your computer and costs nothing. If you prefer a cloud engine, you can plug in your own API key and pay the provider directly, usually one to three dollars a month.
Yes. With the local engine, Whisper runs on your Mac and needs no internet connection after the one-time model download of 547 MB.

items.q: How well does it understand English?
items.a: Hlas uses Whisper large-v3, one of the strongest open speech models for English. Add names and jargon to the vocabulary and Hlas writes them your way.

items.q: How much RAM does it use while dictating?
items.a: About 60 MB when idle. While the local model is loaded it uses about 1 GB, and it unloads after 3 minutes of silence. Hlas Cloud never loads a model at all.

items.q: Does it run on Intel Macs?
items.a: No. The Mac app needs Apple Silicon and macOS 15 or later. Windows 10 and 11 on x64 are supported in beta.

items.q: Can I dictate prompts into Claude Code, Cursor or ChatGPT?
items.a: Yes. Hlas types into any app where you can type, including terminals and code editors. Add library and function names to the vocabulary so they come out right.

items.q: How do invoices and cancellation work?
items.a: After payment, Stripe emails you a VAT invoice from Eden Makers s.r.o. Companies from the EU can enter their VAT ID at checkout. Change your card, download invoices or cancel in the customer portal; the subscription then runs until the end of the paid year.
Hlas Cloud has no minute counter or tiers. To keep the price at €35 a year, fair use is up to 3 hours of dictation a day, which resets at midnight UTC.

With the local engine, nowhere. It stays on your machine. With Hlas Cloud it goes through our server to Groq only for transcription and our server does not store it. With your own key it goes straight to the provider you picked.

final.p: Two minutes from download to your first dictated sentence.
